title: Private deployment Orion weekly sync — 2026-07-13 (prep + notes)
content:
Meeting details:
- Time: 2026-07-13 10:00 PT (Orion weekly sync)
- Attendees (expected): Marta Lopez (Orion), Liam O'Rourke (Orion), Evan Chen (Redwood SE), Priya Rao (Cloud Eng), Daniel Kim (SRE)

Prep notes (internal):
- Goal: get alignment on VPC peering, routing, and firewall rules so on-prem connector can run in staging by 7/20.
- Confirmed with infra that customer-provided subnet tags required for ENIs are documented (see Confluence link).
- Verify whether Orion needs NAT gateway vs. egress via customer firewall for patch updates — bring up as decision.

Agenda (10–20 min):
1) Quick status round (2–3 min)
2) VPC/VPN connectivity: peering setup, CIDR overlap check, routing table updates (5 min)
3) On-prem connector deployment: container image access, registry auth, and KMS integration (5 min)
4) Blockers & action items (5 min)
5) Next steps and target milestones

Current milestones and dates:
- 7/13: finalize VPC peering config and firewall rule list (this week)
- 7/20: deploy connector in staging and validate end-to-end inference (staging smoke)
- 7/27: security review sign-off and plan for production cutover (tentative)

Open blockers (to raise):
- ORION-1245: Customer firewall is blocking outbound to artifact registry (need whitelist IPs). Owner: Marta (Orion) + Evan to provide IP list. Impact: blocks staging deploy. (Linked)
- ORION-1290: KMS key access policy incomplete — ops needs exact principal. Owner: Priya Rao. Action: Priya to propose IAM snippet by 7/14.
- Network CIDR overlap: customer stated 10.0.0.0/16 used both sides; need to plan for NAT or alternate ranges. Owner: Liam O'Rourke.

Pre-meeting checklist (what I need to do before sync):
- Get final set of artifact registry IPs from infra (Evan) — due 7/13 08:00 PT
- Confirm KMS principal format with security (Priya) — follow up before meeting
- Prepare short demo plan for staging smoke test (2–3 steps) and rollback plan

Action items (from prior week and new):
- Evan: Share registry IP allowlist and firewall guidance doc with Marta (due 2026-07-13).
- Marta (Orion): Open ticket with network team to apply allowlist + provide confirmation once applied (due 2026-07-15).
- Priya: Draft KMS policy snippet and post to linked Confluence page (due 2026-07-14). Linked: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ORION/KMS-Integration
- Daniel: Prepare staging runbook for connector rollout (include healthchecks, logging endpoints) (due 2026-07-18).
- Liam: Verify CIDR overlap options and propose short-term NAT approach vs. re-IP (due 2026-07-16).
- All: Join 7/20 staging validation window (TBD time) — calendar invite to follow.

Risks & notes:
- If registry access isn't resolved by 7/15, staging will slip by at least 1 week.
- KMS policy mistakes can block log encryption and inhibit security sign-off; escalate to security manager if not resolved by 7/16.
- Remind Orion to enable VPC flow logs for initial troubleshooting (good practice).

Questions to ask Orion during sync:
- Can your infra team accept a temporary NAT gateway solution if CIDR overlap not resolved by 7/20?
- Who is the primary IAM approver for KMS policies on your side? Name and contact.
- Preferred maintenance window for production cutover (weekdays vs weekends)?

Notes to self (post-meeting follow-up):
- Update ORION-1245 with IPs and status after the call.
- Add short 'how to rollback' snippet to staging runbook and link in runbook PR.
- Schedule a deeper network debug session if routing errors persist after peering.

Quick links:
- Deployment plan (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ORION/Deployment+Plan
- Jira: ORION-1245, ORION-1290
- PR: https://github.com/redwood/rdw-private-deploy/pull/482

---
Scratchpad (for notes during call):
- Marta: registry allowedlist in progress, net team will apply by EOD? need confirmation
- Priya: will try to get KMS principal by morning
- Daniel: runbook draft 50% done, will add healthcheck commands
- Evan: remind to capture traceroute if connectivity fails

End of prep notes.
